display.name: New Relic
display.blurb: Query New Relic during a run — run NRQL and explore entities, dashboards, and alerts via NerdGraph (GraphQL), plus the REST v2 API for applications and alert policies. The user API key is brokered: injected at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `newrelic` to query New Relic from this session. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects your user API key in the `Api-Key` header on every request to api.newrelic.com; `NEW_RELIC_API_KEY` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real key or run any login.

NerdGraph (GraphQL) is the primary API and a single POST endpoint (https://api.newrelic.com/graphql), so it cannot be split into read/write — one coarse power, `nerdgraph:query`, grants it. Run NRQL or any GraphQL query/mutation through it:
  newrelic graphql '{ actor { user { name email } } }'            Run an arbitrary GraphQL query (requires `nerdgraph:query`)
  newrelic nrql <accountId> "SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction SINCE 1 hour ago"   Run NRQL via NerdGraph (requires `nerdgraph:query`)
  newrelic whoami                                                  Show the authenticated user (actor.user; requires `nerdgraph:query`)

REST v2 helpers (each GET path is its own power):
  newrelic apps [filter[name]=foo]      List APM applications — GET /v2/applications.json (requires `applications:read`)
  newrelic transactions                 List key transactions — GET /v2/key_transactions.json (requires `transactions:read`)
  newrelic policies                     List alert policies — GET /v2/alerts_policies.json (requires `alerts:read`)
  newrelic users                        List account users — GET /v2/users.json (requires `users:read`)
  newrelic rest <path> [field=value ...]   Raw REST v2 GET, e.g. `newrelic rest alerts_conditions.json policy_id=123` (path is relative to /v2/; power depends on the resource).

Writing alerts (POST/PUT/DELETE under /v2/alerts_*) requires the `alerts:write` power — use `newrelic rest` with `-X` is not exposed; prefer NerdGraph mutations for changes. A call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.
